name: web-automotive-hero-on-monitor-with-aerial-forest-road-video
title: Car-brand site on a monitor: aerial forest road, big white 'Some see what is. We see beyond.' and campaign card
whatItIs: A monitor on a metal stand showing a full-bleed aerial forest road with a car, a minimal nav with a logo square and a white Menu pill, a large white two-line statement, a Watch Video link, Discover Now and a small dark campaign card with a car thumbnail.
whatItMeans: Cinematic and premium; sparse type over a moody drive feels like a car film.
techniques: Use a full-bleed aerial video hero.
Set a big two-line statement in white.
Add a small dark card in the corner.

vocabulary.definition: A small card promoting a campaign.
A display shown on a stand.
